request_text: 아까 그 첨부 이미지로 이번엔 하이 앵글, 로우 앵글, 동적인 느낌을 줄 수 있는 구도 이렇게 3개 주제로 아까와 같은 방식으로 테스트해줘.
independent_context: Each agent starts without conversation history or other-arm artifacts; the coordinator supplies the byte-exact requester envelope.
reference_role: Visible face and hair appearance guidance for a fictional adult portrayal.
staging: Each agent independently randomizes a physically coherent complex photographic scene before candidate access.
core_protocol: Choose neutral categories, author baseline and focal typed assertion, freeze core/embodiment/test case, validate selection, then retrieve exactly one normal semantic v6 pack.
retry_policy: Preserve first-result evidence; no additional calls, fallback or image modification.
pixel_protocol: All-of topic criteria and frozen scene checks are separate. Partial is fail. Inspect original and reduced scale, then coordinator reads the original pixels against the frozen case.
measurement_boundary: Camera-angle evidence is apparent perspective and visible projection; exact real camera height and focal length are not measured.
source_mutations: None; existing candidate/profile data, indexes, code, fixtures and previous experiment artifacts are preserved.
